introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics 3 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2019. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Answer ALL questions. For your guidance the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated in brackets. Mathematical formulae and tables, published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

The paper contains eight questions.
incertitudes: Question 8(a) : la ligne de la fonction de masse « c(10 - x^2) pour x = 1, 2 ; c(18 - x^2) pour x = 3, 4 » est partiellement masquée par le filigrane ; la lecture est confirmée par la somme 26c = 1 (valeurs entières propres).
Question 8 : points imprimés (2, 2, 5 pour (a)(i) à (iii) et 5 pour (b)) reproduits tels quels.

questions.enonce_markdown: A discrete random variable $X$ has probability mass function defined by $f(x)=\begin{cases}c(10-x^2), & \text{for } x=1,2\\ c(18-x^2), & \text{for } x=3,4\\ 0, & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$ Find the value of the constant $c$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The probabilities must sum to $1$. The values of $f$ are

$$f(1)=c(10-1)=9c,\quad f(2)=c(10-4)=6c,\quad f(3)=c(18-9)=9c,\quad f(4)=c(18-16)=2c.$$

$$9c+6c+9c+2c=26c=1\ \Longrightarrow\ \boxed{c=\frac{1}{26}}.$$

questions.enonce_markdown: A discrete random variable $X$ has probability mass function defined by $f(x)=\begin{cases}c(10-x^2), & \text{for } x=1,2\\ c(18-x^2), & \text{for } x=3,4\\ 0, & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$ Find the median of $X$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The probabilities are $f(1)=\frac{9}{26}$, $f(2)=\frac{6}{26}$, $f(3)=\frac{9}{26}$, $f(4)=\frac{2}{26}$.

Cumulative probabilities: $P(X\le1)=\dfrac{9}{26}\approx0.346<0.5$, and $P(X\le2)=\dfrac{15}{26}\approx0.577\ge0.5$.

The median is the smallest $x$ with $P(X\le x)\ge\frac12$, so $\boxed{\text{median}=2}$.

questions.enonce_markdown: A discrete random variable $X$ has probability mass function defined by $f(x)=\begin{cases}c(10-x^2), & \text{for } x=1,2\\ c(18-x^2), & \text{for } x=3,4\\ 0, & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$ Find the mean and standard deviation of $X$. *[5 marks]*
A continuous random variable $Y$ has normal distribution with mean $4$ and variance $1$. Given that $P(Y>k)=0.025$, determine the value of $k$. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
$Y\sim N(4,\,1)$, so $\sigma=1$. Standardise: $Z=\dfrac{Y-4}{1}\sim N(0,1)$.

$$P(Y>k)=0.025\ \Longrightarrow\ P\left(Z>k-4\right)=0.025\ \Longrightarrow\ P\left(Z\le k-4\right)=0.975.$$

From the normal tables, $\Phi(1.96)=0.975$, so

$$k-4=1.96\ \Longrightarrow\ \boxed{k=5.96}.$$
